title: RL Model environment creation
situation: Worked on a project to develop an AI model for trading stocks using Reinforcement Learning. A key challenge was building a training environment that accurately simulated stock marker dynamics, including buy/sell operations.
task: Design and implement a training environment that replicated real world stock trading condition.
action: - Created a custom simulated stock trading.;- Integrated historical stock data to provide realistic scenarios for model training.;- Created a basic reward function to incentivize profitable trades while penalizing unprofitable ones.
result: The environment provided a robust platform for training and testing various RL algorithms. Making it easy to change reward functions and which data to give to models to better train them.
